headline: Across media, gaming, publishing and education, revenue trends vary while AI and digital platform investments dominate.
summary: Media & Entertainment shows solid revenue growth, especially at Disney, with expanding IT spend on AI. Gaming mixes strong revenue at Caesars with mixed sentiment and varied IT outlooks. Publishing is split between Pearson’s growth and Scholastic’s miss, with AI projects underway. Education sees Pearson’s expansion alongside SLU’s cost cuts, and continued AI funding.

industries.summary: Disney posted $25,248 m revenue up 7% and expanding AI partnerships. WBD and Versant also delivered growth and expanding IT spend. Private players Cox and LA Times add no revenue data.

leaders.why: Revenue $25,248 m and AI partnership with Adobe

laggards.why: No revenue data and neutral sentiment

themes.title: AI & Tech Investment
themes.detail: Multiple firms are building generative AI models and expanding 3D experiences.

themes.title: Digital Platform Expansion
themes.detail: Versant adds FAST channels and grows streaming memberships.

industries.it_note: Tech team should focus on supporting Disney’s Adobe AI integration and Versant’s platform rebuild.

industries.summary: Caesars generated $2,940 m revenue but posted a net loss; Bally's grew revenue 22% to $807.6 m. Light & Wonder and Brightstar show flat or declining results.

themes.title: Digital Platform Rebuild
themes.detail: Investments in iGaming and new lottery tech drive modest digital revenue growth.

themes.title: AI Selective Adoption
themes.detail: Caesars hints at AI augmenting but not replacing face‑to‑face meetings.

industries.it_note: Balance support for stable iGaming platforms with cost‑control initiatives at Light & Wonder.

industries.summary: Pearson posted $1,779 m revenue and expanding AI tools. Scholastic missed revenue at $216.8 m with a large operating loss. Wolters Kluwer adds AI capabilities but provides no financials.

leaders.why: Highest revenue $1,779 m and AI rollout

themes.title: AI & Tech Investment
themes.detail: Pearson and Wolters Kluwer are launching AI‑powered learning and legal tools.

themes.title: Revenue Pressure
themes.detail: Scholastic’s miss highlights challenges in traditional publishing models.

industries.it_note: Prioritize AI integration support for Pearson’s new Studio suite and Wolters Kluwer’s Libra AI.
